title: Titus
lead: Titus was a Gentile co-worker of Paul, never named in Acts. He went with Paul to Jerusalem uncircumcised (Galatians 2:1-5), carried Paul's painful letter to Corinth, brought back the good news that reconciled the church (2 Corinthians 7:5-16), organized the collection there (2 Corinthians 8:6, 16-24), and was later left on Crete (Titus 1:5).
